text:
Riya: Quick poll — lunchtime plan tomorrow: gentle yoga on the roof (20m) or a 4k social run that passes the coffee cart? :sun_with_face:
Noah: Run for me. Coffee cart inclusion is non-negotiable. :coffee:
Bea: Yoga please. My knees need mercy and the roof view is excellent for savasana. :person_in_lotus_position:
Carlos: I can do either but midweek runs wreck my hair. Vote yoga.
Riya: Ok yoga currently 2, run 1. If run wins, meet breakroom at 12:10 and we hit the river loop. If yoga wins, 12:15 rooftop — bring a mat or towel.
Noah: Also greatness incentive: whoever convinces the most people to join gets to pick breakfast for the squad on Friday. Winner chooses. :crown:
Bea: High stakes. I will use my persuasive voice.
plants-bot: Reminder: rooftop capacity is limited to 12. Please respect social distancing and cleanup rules.
Carlos: If rooftop fills up, we can do an indoor yoga in the huddle room — windows open.
Riya: Final votes?
Noah: RSVP: run (will bring hand wipes).
Bea: RSVP: yoga (mat incoming).
Carlos: RSVP: yoga (huddle fallback).
Riya: RSVP: yoga.
plants-bot: Event created: "Lunch Wellness — Yoga vs Run" 12:15 tomorrow. Optional.
Riya: Cool. Yoga it is — see you on the roof. Bring sunscreen if it's sunny. :sunglasses:
